items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) did not practice for the second straight day.
items.implication: Likely out again; elevated TE/WR targets
items.opportunity: Schultz target share spike (28-30% routes last week)

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart officially placed on IR after knee surgery (MCL/meniscus; ACL intact). Season-ending for regular season; possible playoff return door left open but unlikely.
items.implication: Giants QB situation unsettled long-term; dart owners drop

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) missed practice for the second straight day; looking like he will miss a second consecutive game. Travel to Brazil complicates recovery.
items.why: No practice Wed/Thu; Brazil trip; origin Aug 20 aggravation after W1 big half
items.implication: Sit Flowers; Ravens WR depth elevated
items.opportunity: Increased targets for other Ravens pass-catchers

items.text: After good MRI results on stinger, Saquon Barkley is on the practice field suited up and expects to play Monday vs Bears.
items.why: Good MRI + on-field practice + self-report expects play
items.implication: Start Barkley with confidence in MNF spot

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected on IR (only 5 games across 3 seasons). Pushes Chuba Hubbard firmly into lead role (RB14 utilization); AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
items.implication: Hubbard clear lead back; strong start

items.text: Love Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 ypg. Feed him.
items.why: Elite matchup vs bottom rush D + prop line
items.implication: Strong RB1 start in Brazil game

items.text: Drake London has played 12 career games with Michael Penix: over 20 PPR PPG, 35% target share, 97 rec yds/game. Levitan flags Penix health as key to revive London/Pitts on TNF.
items.why: Historical production spike with Penix; TNF return
items.implication: London/Pitts boom potential if Penix healthy

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua on the field as a Ram, targeted on 60 of them (42%). Results in two games Puka missed: 5-35-3 vs JAX (2025) and 8-195-2 vs NYG.
items.why: Elite target rate and production in Nacua absences
items.implication: Adams is a high-end WR1 with or without Nacua short-term
items.opportunity: 42% target share on routes without Nacua; red-zone upside

items.text: Zay Flowers first hurt hamstring in joint practice Aug 20. Seemed fine for regular season, 5-150-1 first half W1 then aggravated; hasn't practiced full since. Ravens travel to Brazil this week.
items.implication: High risk even if active; prefer other options

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert (MCL sprain) expected to miss a few weeks / multi-week absence; DNP Thursday. Avoided IR so far; Ertz signed to PS.
Love Chase Brown @ PIT: at least 20 touches + 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization (86). PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Love Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards. LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.why: Volume + deep threat vs soft secondary

items.text: Hate Travis Etienne vs LV: even with Kamara active last week only RB37 utilization; 49% RB touches, 38% third-down snaps. Role isn't there.
items.implication: Sit or fade in most formats
